releaseNotes: Public preview SDK for NexatomTT on Linux x64, built and verified on Ubuntu 24.04 under WSL2 (standalone C/C++ build and Python load after extraction).

Adds the shared result model (one STOPPED result per processor after Stop), callbacks by value, board selection by USB port (connection_id; the FT601 serial is information only), auto-reconnect, nexatom_tt_get_file_saving_statistics, a statically linked runtime and CSV/TAB v2 and HDF5 schema 4 files; examples and manual updated.
Hardware checks for this preview ran on Windows (Kintex K168_004 and Zynq Z080_004); no Linux hardware run is claimed for this preview.
Follow the included FTDI USB access instructions. Firmware catalogue 3 (Z080_004, K168_004) is included in firmware/. External analog validation and maximum sustained throughput remain pending.
